summary: A 1920 ground cabin on Payette NF's Tailholt Peak, with a 1931 staffing note, destroyed in 1952; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1952. No source describes what remains at the site today.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in.

events.note: A government employee had charge of the lookout that summer, per a 1931 newspaper item quoted on the Forest Lookouts site

evidence.supports: Valley County, Payette National Forest, about 23 miles northeast of McCall

evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: 1931 staffing: government employee had charge of the lookout that summer
evidence.quote: who is employed by the government and has charge of Tailholt lookout for this summer.

evidence.supports: code 20N-6E-11 listed on the Forest Lookouts page

notes_for_editor: The 1931 staffing item is quoted secondhand on the Forest Lookouts page; the Idaho Evening Times original was not read, and the story does not name the person. No source gives a cause for the 1952 destruction. A web search turned up a Roamze hiking page for a Tailholt in Payette NF; it is marked as an AI-suggested draft, names no lookout, and was not used. The Payette display text does not name this site. Record fields: built year and staffing were blank and are now in events; status gone is consistent with the sources.
